name: MonarchText
title: Text
summary: Text in one of the nine Monarch type roles.
whenToUse: For text that is not inside another Monarch or Material 3 component.
whenNotToUse: Inside Material 3 slots that already set a style (a button label, a list item headline) use Text.
api: @Composable fun MonarchText(text: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, style: MonarchTextStyle = MonarchTextStyle.Body, color: Color = Color.Unspecified, textAlign: TextAlign? = null, overflow: TextOverflow = TextOverflow.Clip, softWrap: Boolean = true, maxLines: Int = Int.MAX_VALUE, minLines: Int = 1, heading: Boolean = style.isHeading)

@Composable fun MonarchText(text: AnnotatedString, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, style: MonarchTextStyle = MonarchTextStyle.Body, color: Color = Color.Unspecified, textAlign: TextAlign? = null, overflow: TextOverflow = TextOverflow.Clip, softWrap: Boolean = true, maxLines: Int = Int.MAX_VALUE, minLines: Int = 1, heading: Boolean = style.isHeading)

options.name: style
options.description: Display, Title, Heading, Subheading, Body, BodyStrong, Label, Caption, Code or CodeSmall.

options.name: color
options.description: Unspecified uses the content color of the surrounding surface.

options.name: overflow
options.description: What happens to text that does not fit.

options.name: heading
options.default: true for Display, Title, Heading, Subheading

states.name: default
states.description: The style of the role in the content color.

appearance: The color is the content color of the surface, so it changes with the theme. Size, weight, line height and tracking come from the type tokens and are the same in every theme.
platformNotes: The type roles and their sizes are the same as on iOS. The typeface is the system typeface unless the app passes one; the web uses Poppins. Sizes are sp; from Android 14 the system scales large text less than linearly.
accessibility: Sizes are in sp and follow the font size setting.
Display, Title, Heading and Subheading are announced as headings; the heading parameter overrides this.
Line height and tracking are in em, so they stay in proportion at every size.
edgeCases: maxLines with TextOverflow.Ellipsis cuts text at large font sizes; prefer wrapping.
A color passed here does not change with the surface; use a theme role.
